approval_boundary: A01-A06 are approved as recorded. Exact operational fields/layout and clarification defaults below are draft implementation choices for owner review; no case authoring or later-stage permission is granted.

allowed: General AML knowledge, which cannot establish absent source facts or invent policy requirements
construction_context.assessment_boundary: No baseline/hosted candidate assessment, API request, feedback-driven tuning, reference-answer generation or numerical semantic scoring during Gate A.
construction_context.generation_export: Export only approved investigation input records. Keep ancestry, scenario/selection metadata, references, adjudications and accounting separate from producer input; generic source check conclusions are attributed records, not independent verification.
construction_context.historical_material: Development cases, outputs, references and generator recipes may be consulted for disclosed ancestry comparison, not as undisclosed construction templates.
construction_context.ordering: Source-only construction precedes ancestry comparison where operationally feasible. Record reasons for a different sequence and actual influences; never claim prior knowledge was erased or assistants blinded.
construction_context.tools: Manual versioned JSON and unchanged existing input validation/canonical hashing; actual Codex/ChatGPT assistance only as expressly instructed. No new software/helper implementation or external provider request is included.

counting_and_capacity_rules: Six distinct candidate proposals/variants maximum; every proposed variant spends its own slot even if later rejected, quarantined or withdrawn. No automatic replacement/replenishment.
Maximum intended coverage is three substantively distinct mechanism families, not a minimum or a claim that novelty is established. Record provisional family/group labels and substantive reasoning.
Do not proceed to a proposed fourth intended family or seventh proposal; hold for a separately approved prospective amendment.

Metadata versions and corrections to the same proposal do not by themselves create a new case. A genuinely different investigation/variant needs a new consumed slot. Ambiguity is held for owner disposition before further work.
Grouping, merging, withdrawal or relabelling never resets consumed slots or erases earlier intake/family history.
Hours stay flexible. Advance at verified checkpoints; stop early if review capacity, source traceability/quality or credible mechanism coverage is insufficient.
Valid missing/null/conflicting records are not inherently poor quality or exclusion grounds. Do not seek a desired action, balanced action labels or favorable system outcomes.
These are engineering pilot ceilings, not statistical power, independence, significance or representative-sampling claims.

destinations_and_preservation.approval_needed: Owner review of exact layout, record versions and preservation procedure before operational use; actual write/copy/archive/upload permissions must be explicit.
destinations_and_preservation.current_operations: No population directory, archive, copy, backup or cloud operation is created/performed by this package.
destinations_and_preservation.git_ignore_observed: Existing outputs/ rule; ignored is not independently preserved.
destinations_and_preservation.procedure: Keep original source/control versions and exact inventories; separately identify local/off-device preservation scope, access, method/cadence and recovery verification under approved operations. Do not assume F1 archives cover new population records.

proposed_relative_layout.control/intake/: Versioned intake identities and counting history.
proposed_relative_layout.control/preservation/: Approved scope/inventory and actual verification receipts.
proposed_relative_layout.references/: Reserved for separately authorized F2; no references created or authorized here.
proposed_relative_layout.sources/: Actual raw case inputs only after authoring release.

first_case_workflow_after_separate_autho.action: Verify actual owner Gate A permission binds this reviewed package, completed F1 and approved role/tool/scope limits; check the next slot and intended family coverage before writing.

Create the first actual intake identity and consume a non-reusable proposal slot; record actual author/assistant roles and known construction context. This is the first future case-related action, not an action performed now.

Prepare a bounded source-only draft in the approved synthetic envelope. Preserve missing/conflicting supplied information and do not create expected AML labels, candidate assessments or reference answers.
Record exact source bytes; run only separately permitted existing input-contract validation and canonical identity checks; preserve diagnostics and version any correction.
Complete mechanism-level ancestry/exposure comparison using disclosed historical material, record parent/sibling groups and uncertainty; explain any infeasible source-first ordering.
Record provisional screening and owner handling of contested/quarantined items. Rejected/quarantined proposals keep their spent slots; no F3 eligibility claim is made.
Preserve source/control versions under the specifically approved procedure and verify the checkpoint. Stop early on insufficient capacity/quality/coverage; no assessment runs.
Seek separate F2 source/reference review/freeze and later separate F3 roster/partition release; do not infer either from Gate A construction permission.

identity_and_versioning.canonical_validated_input: Use the frozen existing validated InvestigationInput representation and recorded canonicalization basis, labelled separately from raw bytes: model_dump(mode=json), sorted-key compact JSON, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, UTF-8 without terminal newline.
identity_and_versioning.hash_binding: The decision record binds earlier F1/governance; this specification binds the decision/F1. A future actual authorization binds these exact reviewed bytes, never a reciprocal/self digest.
identity_and_versioning.identifiers: Allocate actual proposal/case/alert/family/group IDs only under authoring permission; unique within the study and compatible with unchanged contracts. No actual ID or reserved case instance is allocated here.
identity_and_versioning.metadata_separation: Control/ancestry/exposure/reference records remain separate from input, without changing InvestigationInput or hosted instructions.
identity_and_versioning.raw_bytes: Hash exact supplied source file bytes before validation; record original byte size and SHA-256. Never normalize/reconstruct originals.
identity_and_versioning.validation: Unchanged input contract and cross-record checks only. Passing establishes structural/reference validity, not authenticity, semantic support, eligibility or correct AML disposition.
identity_and_versioning.versions: Exclusive non-overwriting files or append-only events; each actual artifact retains bytes/hash/version and supersession links. No silent normalization, deletion or retroactive approval.

limitations: Owner-led author/reviewer overlap and prior development exposure remain; no independent authorship, blinding, AML expertise or statistical significance is claimed.
F1 is complete within approved scope, not a held-out-family eligibility certificate.
P01/P02 remain settled. P03 scoring is unresolved/disabled; P04/P05 and later execution/report release remain separately controlled.
These are compact planning/control definitions, not application implementation, executed tests, an automatic novelty checker or an actual populated study ledger.

rules: Every distinct proposal/variant consumes one slot immediately, regardless of subsequent rejection, quarantine or withdrawal.

rules: Existing F1 archives do not automatically cover new Gate A records or sources.

roles.ChatGPT: Assistance only with material explicitly shared by owner; record actual context and influence.
roles.Codex: Bounded assistance, mechanical input validation/hashing and ancestry recommendations only when separately instructed; not independent human review.
roles.all_actors: Actual authors, reviewers, overlap and assistance recorded per task/proposal. No fixed hours or independent/AML-expert actor is invented.
roles.project_owner: Accountable for preparation, eligibility decisions and authorization. Actual F2/F3 decisions require their separate permissions.

scope: Manual, source-only synthetic case preparation within existing InvestigationInput and fictional-policy scope after a separate Gate A release. No new generator, runner, service, scoring logic or frozen contract change.

selection_rules.final_roster: F3 binds reviewed family/related-group and F2 source/reference identities before assessment generation; no actual roster/partition is selected here.
selection_rules.if_sampling_becomes_necessary: HOLD. Obtain explicit prospective owner approval for selection unit, related-group handling and algorithm before use. If sources already exist, the amendment must explicitly address chronology and claim limitations; do not describe an after-the-fact rule as originally predeclared.
selection_rules.initial_preference: Complete eligible roster from bounded candidate intake, subject to actual F2/F3 decisions and capacity.
selection_rules.preserve_history: Keep rejected, quarantined, withdrawn, eligible and superseded proposals with reasons and related-group links.
selection_rules.prospective_sampling_boundary: A05 is read with PF04/OP06: selection strategy, authoring constraints and any sampling procedure must be prospective before source authoring. No automatic later sampling fallback is granted.

serialization: UTF-8 without BOM; sorted keys; two-space indentation; finite JSON; LF plus terminal newline.
stop_conditions: Missing/ambiguous actual authoring approval or package/F1 identity mismatch.
Unexpected frozen component, prompt, schema, model/configuration or runtime change; no silent repair or fallback.
A new proposal/variant or intended family would exceed the six/three ceilings; no replacement/replenishment.
Insufficient review capacity, traceable source quality or credible coverage at a verified checkpoint; no calendar-pressure override.
Unresolved material ancestry, contamination, exposure or related-group conflict: hold/quarantine affected eligibility, preserve evidence and seek owner disposition.
Unauthorized tools/context, candidate assessment/API use, reference generation, feedback-driven tuning or outcome-dependent selection.
Sampling needed without a separately approved prospective rule/amendment.
Invalid/untraceable source or ambiguous revision-versus-variant counting: version diagnostics and hold affected work; no source/frozen-system alteration outside scope.
Overwrite, missing required provenance, failed preservation/integrity check or operation outside approved permissions.
